# Honora Hollis & Nell Harcourt

- [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — close friends and driven scholars · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjust to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approach, balancing academic rivalry and friendships. Meanwhile, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues visiting [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and maintains a positive perspective on her studies and upcoming examinations.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit Daniel Blair.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) spend a spring Saturday exploring the woods and fields together. Along their path, they encounter a quiet pool they name [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and discover an abandoned, flower-filled garden. Sitting among the narcissi, Isolde tells the story of [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) and [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Wren, the couple who originally created the hidden garden.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Isolde finish talking about [Dinah Wren](../character/dinah-wren.md) before spending the rest of the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. They discuss nature, poetry, and what souls might look like before gathering narcissus blossoms and walking home at sunset.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P60](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0060), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

> While waiting in the duckhouse, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes down a garden conversation with Isolde's assistance. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp frees [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a hatchet, feeds the girls, and agrees to sell them her willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars, revealing she plans to get married. The girls then drive away with the platter along [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road).
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) depart for town, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) at home. While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.
>
